newsitem.title: UK: Captain Pugwash to sail again with Britt.
newsitem.headline: Captain Pugwash to sail again with Britt.

text.p: Captain Pugwash, a well known British children's television programme during the 1960s and 70s, is set to sail again after British entertainment distributor Britt Allcroft Company Plc bought the world-wide rights to the show.

The company, which purchased the rights to the animated programme about the adventures of a pirate captain and his crew from John Cary Films, will finance production of a new television series of 26 episodes at a cost of around 1.5 million pounds.

The new series will be produced in London by John Cary Films and is due to be released for the Autumn 1998 schedule. Captain Pugwash first appeared on BBC television in 1957, but has not been seen on Brtitish screens for over 20 years.
Britt Allcroft was floated on the London stock exchange last November and produces, distributes and licenses entertainment properties such as children's story character Thomas The Tank Engine.
